rfbList.imageAltText: Platter with meats, buns, nachos and dip
rfbList.listPreamble: At 60° Bar & Brewery, you’ll experience the spirit of travel together with the calm, comfortable feeling you get at your local pub.
rfbList.name: 60° Bar & Brewery

remarks: One hour before the first departure until last departure.

rfbList.listPreamble: Baba Grill's core concept is to serve everything in a wrap. The menu features refined recipes based on falafel, shawarma, and halloumi, served alongside mezze inspired by the most prominent culinary traditions of the Middle East.
rfbList.name: Baba Grill

rfbList.listPreamble: High-quality espresso, well-known Italian non-alcoholic drinks and food with popular flavours from Italy are served here 24/7.
rfbList.name: Barino Italian Inspired Café

businessHours.period: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

rfbList.listPreamble: High-quality espresso, well-known Italian drinks and food with popular flavours from Italy are served here.
rfbList.name: Barino Italian Inspired Cuisine

rfbList.listPreamble:
Brew’d has a wide assortment with a menu that changes depending on the time of day. You can order prepared food that can be eaten standing up as well as hot dishes made to order. Take the opportunity to order the restaurant’s signature hot dog, which is served with the appropriate fixings.

We look forward to seeing you.
rfbList.name: Brew'd

remarks: Opens 1 hour before first departure, closes at last departure

rfbList.imageAltText: Two burgers, fries, milkshake and drink
rfbList.listPreamble: Bun Meat Bun is a burger restaurant where you can enjoy great food in a relaxed setting. Every burger is made to order using freshly ground chuck, pressed onto the griddle to achieve a delicious seared crust.
rfbList.name: Bun Meat Bun

rfbList.imageAltText: An espresso in blue cup with biscotti and a spoon on the saucer.
rfbList.listPreamble: At Ritazza, the coffee is the centre of attention. This is the classic kind of café that you’ll find in bus terminals and railway stations all across Italy.
rfbList.name: Caffè Ritazza

rfbList.imageAltText: Three plates, each with a sandwich on it and two bowls in the back, one containing soup and one containing grilled vegatables.
rfbList.listPreamble: C/C Cornelius Coffee is a perfect meeting place for everyone who loves fresh coffee, Swedish fika and home-made food.
rfbList.name: C/C Cornelius Coffee

rfbList.imageAltText: Hamburger and fries on plate with a glass of beer in the background.
rfbList.listPreamble: Craft n' Draft is a modern gastro pub with a focus on combining quality beer with well-made food.
rfbList.name: Craft n' Draft

rfbList.listPreamble: At Eatery, there’s something for every taste and time of day. The menu has a clear international flavour, with strong influences from Mediterranean countries.
rfbList.name: Eatery

rfbList.imageAltText: Plates and bowls with colourful meals against a concrete background.
rfbList.listPreamble: Eatery Garden is a casual, family-style dining concept. Anyone traveling either in large groups, with family or alone can enjoy a fun and playful restaurant that is open 24/7.
rfbList.name: Eatery Garden

rfbList.listPreamble: You can buy face masks and hand sanitisers in vendor machines. Please note, Selectas vending machine in Terminal 2 is temporarily out of face masks.
rfbList.name: Selecta vendor machine

spotsInfo.name: Selecta Vendor Machine
spotsInfo.gateAreaName: Baggage Hall, at special baggage belt C

spotsInfo.name: Selecta vendor machine
spotsInfo.gateAreaName: Arrival Hall, near elevators to Arlanda express

rfbList.listPreamble: The baristas at Espresso House strive to give their guests a world-class coffee experience. Along with good coffee, you'll find a wide menu with hot and cold drinks, breakfast, light meals and delicious baked goods.
rfbList.name: Espresso House

rfbList.listPreamble: Gateau offers a high-quality Swedish fika. Here, you'll find a large variety of different baked goods, sandwiches and salads.
rfbList.name: Gateau

rfbList.listPreamble: Hawaii Poké serves healthy fast food with flavours from all around the world. Poké (poh-kay) is a delicious fish dish from Hawaii, with influences from Japan. It is best described as a sushi salad.
rfbList.name: Hawaii Poké

rfbList.listPreamble: Indochine offers the best of Asian cuisine, featuring dishes inspired by every corner of Asia, with a focus on distinctive and pure flavors.
rfbList.name: Indochine

rfbList.imageAltText: Glasses with freshly pressed juice, fruits and berries.
rfbList.listPreamble: At Joe & The Juice, everything from energy shots to real juice meals, filled with superfood ingredients, is served. Not in the mood for juice? Organic coffee, tasty sandwiches and fresh bowls are also served here.
rfbList.name: Joe & The Juice

rfbList.listPreamble: At Jureskogs, they want to change people’s view of fast food. Their philosophy is that fast food doesn’t have to mean junk food. High-quality hamburgers are served here. The only thing that’s actually fast is the preparation process.
rfbList.name: Jureskogs

rfbList.imageAltText: Mosaic table set with plates of different shellfish dishes, wine and coca-cola.
rfbList.listPreamble: La Girafe is Pontus Frithiof’s interpretation of multicultural Paris. With a menu that is both recognisable and surprising – featuring food that reflects France’s long and varied history – La Girafe has something for everyone.
rfbList.name: La Girafe by Pontus Frithiof

rfbList.listPreamble: La Neta is a Mexican concept born in Stockholm, focusing on tacos and quesadillas. With its selection of “wrapped” dishes, the restaurant has already made an impact on the international market.
rfbList.name: La Neta

rfbList.imageAltText: Plates of pasta dishes and glasses with white wine on table.
rfbList.listPreamble: The charm of Little Italy - the big city energy of New York. Enjoy a crisp, thin-crust pizza, pasta dishes cooked to perfection, a juicy burger or an authentic Italian sandwich, all prepared with only the best ingredients - for a dining experience that will transport you to the heart of the city.
rfbList.name: Little Italy by Pontus Frithiof

rfbList.imageAltText: Hamburger with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and cheese.
rfbList.listPreamble: At MAX you can order burgers made from Swedish beef or Swedish chicken, but naturally there’s also a wide assortment of plant-based burgers and grilloumi burgers.
rfbList.name: Max

rfbList.imageAltText: Hand holding up a cheeseburger over a tray with french fries and a drink.
rfbList.listPreamble: The American hamburger giant is a sure thing – you know what you're getting.
rfbList.name: McDonalds

rfbList.listPreamble: Nordic Lounge by RC serves both international and traditional nordic dishes. Everything is made by hand, and it's the craftmanship that make the place unique.
rfbList.name: Nordic Kitchen & Bar

rfbList.listPreamble: At Panini Internazionale, healthy fast food is prepared with care. Real food, thoughtfully made from scratch using high-quality ingredients and completely free from unnecessary additives. We ensure fast service—that’s why we can call it fast food.
rfbList.name: Panini Internazionale

rfbList.imageAltText: Toast with a creamy shrimp salad and roe with a lemon slice on the side on a plate.
rfbList.listPreamble: Pocket Bar & Bistro is a comfortable and elegant Swedish bistro, one floor up in SkyCity. The restaurant offers the very best of views over the take-off and landing strip.
rfbList.name: Pocket Bar & Bistro

rfbList.listPreamble: RC Glacier & Café is the perfect place for ice cream lovers. The ice cream and sorbet flavours are adapted to always reflect the flavours of the season.
rfbList.name: RC Bon Bon Glacerie

rfbList.listPreamble: French-inspired patisserie with exclusive treats from its own bakery. Here, you can buy everything from delicious pastries and fantastic pralines to hearty sandwiches and nice salads.
rfbList.name: RC Café & Pâtisserie

rfbList.imageAltText: Woman eating a dinner of salmon, asparagus, couscous, garlic bread and greens.
rfbList.listPreamble: Enjoy a tasty food experience with an exciting view towards the landing runways. Here, you'll find food to suit every hour of the day.
rfbList.name: Sky Horizon

rfbList.listPreamble: At Sky Market, you'll find three different kitchens under the same roof - Taco Bar, Pong Express and Mezefabriken - that offer internationally inspired street food.
rfbList.name: Sky Market

rfbList.listPreamble: Samla City Bar is a natural gathering place before your departure. The bar goes from serving barista coffee in the morning to wine, beer and cocktails in the evening. The drinks menu is mainly made up of local brands, supplemented with international classics in each category.
rfbList.name: Samla City Bar

rfbList.listPreamble: Sushi Yama är en restaurang där alla gäster kan checka in för en god, snabb lunch, en take away på språng eller en lugnare sittning före avgång.
rfbList.name: Sushi Yama

rfbList.listPreamble: Sweets By Camilla erbjuder nybakat, generösa smaker och en varm miljö för alla som älskar söta stunder.
rfbList.name: Sweets by Camilla

rfbList.imageAltText: Two sandwhich halves in a carton box.
rfbList.listPreamble: The assortment available here works for every hour of the day, with a broad range of sandwiches, salads, light dishes, baked goods, snacks, coffee and cold drinks.
rfbList.name: Take Away Mart

rfbList.imageAltText: Meatballs, mashed potatoes, brown sauce, pickles and lingonberry.
rfbList.listPreamble: At Taste by Nordrest, breakfast, a lunch and dinner buffet, hearty sandwiches and salads are served. If you want something sweet after your meal, tasty pastries and cookies are available.
rfbList.name: Taste by Nordrest

rfbList.listPreamble: Welcome to The Social Bar & Bistro at Clarion Hotel. The international bar and bistro that offers a home away from home for travellers passing through the Nordic region. You can eat a quick meal here before your flight or enjoy a delicious three-course dinner. The bistro is designed to feel like a second living room so that you can comfortably unwind before your next adventure.
rfbList.name: The Social Bar & Bistro

rfbList.listPreamble: At Upstairs & Bar, you’ll find an international menu with a touch of Scandinavian flavours – for example, classic Swedish meatballs or the ever-popular hamburger.
rfbList.name: Upstairs & Bar

rfbList.listPreamble:
At Way Cup, you get a modern café experience with an international feel. You’re greeted here by the lovely smell of coffee. Baristas serve coffee of the highest quality and are passionate about providing a fantastic coffee experience whatever kind of coffee you want. Café in the Clouds uses carefully selected premium coffee beans from environmentally-certified growers.

We look forward to seeing you.
rfbList.name: Way Cup

rfbList.listPreamble: 7-Eleven is the perfect stop before you hit the skies! For the hungry, we offer everything from delicious salads, to hot dogs, candy and Swedish fika. If you are looking for entertainment or comfort, we have magazines, presents and travel pillows. Welcome to 7-Eleven!
rfbList.name: 7-Eleven

rfbList.listPreamble: Pressbyrån is Sweden’s largest chain of convenience stores and is an excellent choice for people who need to buy something for their flight or who forgot a few essentials at home.
rfbList.name: Pressbyrån

remarks: Opens 1 hour before the first departure and closes at the last departure.
